name: 89109 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89109 (Las Vegas) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89109 (Las Vegas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 89109 (Las Vegas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
